data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 189.719m. Using the gross claims development triangle the syndicate recorded net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 13.8m (a 7.3% strengthening relative to opening gross reserves). The adverse movement is driven by unfavourable claims development in older underwriting years (notably 2018 and 2016) and reflects general adverse claims development and economic/claims cost pressures; the syndicate also highlights COVID-19 as a material influence on 2020 experience. Scenario testing (RDS, AEP and internal liability scenarios) shows material catastrophe and cyber exposures that are monitored.
raw_causal_phrases: exceptional impact of COVID-19, primarily on contingency class where the Syndicate had exposure to events cancellation risks.
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single-line gross prior-year movement note was located. Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 39-40) per the prescribed diagonal method, excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019, 2020). Exact gross PYD therefore is derived rather than directly stated. No LOB split of prior-year movement is provided in the notes, so LOB movement amounts are not quantified. The exact_reserve_text used is a generic policy sentence describing treatment of prior-year adjustments rather than a sentence giving a gross PYD amount.
